integration_issues.issue: testVec() requires player object to be initialized in a game mode before testing. Cannot test in isolation from settings menu.
integration_issues.workaround: Start a game mode first, then test fling mechanics
integration_issues.note: This is expected behavior - the function needs game context

integration_issues.issue: Passport button click was blocked by overlay interception during automated testing
integration_issues.workaround: Used force click or direct API calls
integration_issues.note: Manual testing works fine, this is a test automation issue
